text_block_list.text:
At a fast food restaurant, I ran into 
Tosen Jordan and the others.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~â Jordan's Traaiineeer! Good job 
todayyy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're right. Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wanna join? Huh? Like, to celebrate 
running into each other? Eating together 
makes it uber delish~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? Wait, Helios~~...!

It wouldn't be right to interrupt when 
friends are having such a good time 
together...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Holding back is hilarious! You're my 
Trainer! Why not, right? Let's hype it up 
and dig in~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Once Helios gets like this, she won't 
listen to a thing. Just give it up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry up, pick a seat, and order~? 
I'm broke, so I'm getting a cheap set 
combo~...

text_block_list.name: In-Store Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—Our Mega Portion Upgrade Campaign is 
currently underway~☆ Un-be-lievable! Any 
item on the menu is the exact same price 
for all sizes...—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wha-?! Oh no! They only have XL in stock!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way, seriously?! That's crazy!! Gimme 
mega portions of both the fries and the 
juice, please~~!!
choice_data_list: I'll get an S size so I don't overeat.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way, seriously?! That's crazy!! Gimme 
mega portions of both the fries and the 
juice, please~~!!
choice_data_list: I'll get an S size so I don't overeat.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? XL is fine, isn't it? It's a great 
opportunity and all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ yeah! Totally get it. Gaining weight 
is a big sad.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! I'd pass on that too, but still~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, idea! If I just get taller, I won't 
get fat, right? Calcium~? Should I go for 
an XL yogurt shake?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, it's not gonna grow that fast! Kuku! 
Buhaha! My stomach hurts~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the hardest I've laughed all 
day. Looking at you makes all my anger 
just vanish~.

And so, keeping portions in moderation, 
everyone enjoyed their meal together.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Look at you getting into the 
spirit for once!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahaーーー!! This portion is 
insane~~! Alright, posting to Umastagram~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Looks suuuper tasty~! I'm seriously so 
happy right now!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the food~♪ Come on, you eat 
too, it's best while it's piping hot, 
right?

And so, Tosen Jordan ate her fill of her 
beloved junk food...!
